degree_rationale: The Twelve Thrones / Eyes of Glory established in cosmos — thrones of Father, Mother of Life, First Man, Beloved, Great Builder, Living Spirit, Ambassador, Jesus, Great Mind. Essential settled-stations.
direction_rationale: The thrones are the ultimate seat of celestial powers — settled, instituted forever, west-quality of completion in established form.
grand_man_function: Celestial enthronement — the ultimating of love into seats of dominion.
title: The Twelve Thrones / Eyes of Glory established in the cosmos
